commands: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v (inside the Linux build image)
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/integration -p test_*.py -v (inside the Linux build image)
Explicit offline integration: tests/integration/run.sh; see tests/README.md for pinned workspaces, variant selection and fresh outputs
ZMK_TEST_OUTPUT=FRESH bash tests/run-native.sh RESOLVED_WORKSPACE; real driver API/layer dispatch, same binary3 times, no settings dependency
preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All host behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported; offline-admission and coverage-validator units once.
execution.full: Same host scenarios plus optimization/coverage; actual kernel boundary and supported stock/DYA core compilation use separate documented entries.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.
execution.coverage: Whole production driver and actual structs are compiled together; every real function, line and branch must be measured. Arithmetic header is independently gated by its owner fixture. Empty/partial/unexecuted coverage controls remain.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split/sensor delivery, timing/power and missing-source recovery remain separate.
Native is actual driver API/layer dispatch, not input-queue or physical HID evidence.
Suppression/frame/HID-pair/settings contracts are outside this pure converter; see tests/README.md.
suppression_extraction: Source buttons are transparent. Final disposition/frame assertions belong to zmk-input-suppress and explicit composition fixtures; current map in tests/README.md.
